summary: Actual volatile teacher-author flow confirms the existing deletion recovery is usable: deleting the rendered own-topic action leaves the controller on the deleted detail URL, which renders an unavailable-conversation fallback and a Back to Forum link. Returning preserves the search that matched the deleted topic, shows the existing no-results empty state, and Clear search recovers all three seeded topic cards. The synthetic topic is owned by demo-teacher; fixture initialization produced two legitimate runtime receipts and no further receipts were created by community actions. No deletion, route, empty-state, authority, reply, or renderer defect was demonstrated; no source change is recommended.
proposed_smallest_correction: None. Reuse existing unavailable-detail fallback, Back to Forum navigation, search empty state, and Clear search recovery. Minimum regression if future route requirements change: volatile actual fixture -> create own topic -> search-match it -> open rendered delete action -> verify successful deletion/fallback/back link -> return and verify no-results state -> clear search and verify seeded index recovery, while asserting existing foreign-owner/anonymous/moderator/hidden/reply-delete behavior is unchanged.
